description: Source code for the MacNodeBrowserProxy actor, which manages network requests and file proxying for Mac node browser functionality within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: MacNodeBrowserProxy
classes.description: An actor responsible for handling network requests, proxying files, and managing interactions with a local Mac node browser endpoint.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a network request based on the provided JSON parameters and returns the response as a JSON string.

methods.name: defaultEndpoint
methods.description: Provides the default endpoint configuration for network requests.

methods.name: decodeRequestParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into request parameters.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Constructs a URLRequest from request parameters and endpoint configuration.

methods.name: requireHTTPResponse
methods.description: Ensures the URLResponse is an HTTPURLResponse, throws otherwise.

methods.name: httpErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message from HTTP status code and data.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Converts various value types into string representations.

methods.name: loadProxyFiles
methods.description: Loads proxy files from a JSON result.

methods.name: collectProxyPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects file paths for proxying from JSON payload.

methods.name: loadProxyFile
methods.description: Loads and encodes a file at a given path into a ProxyFilePayload.
